name: Push Press
progressions: strict overhead press with heavier load
common_faults: forward lean at the dip phase
dipping too deep losing bar control
early elbow bend before leg drive transfers

substitutions.note: strict press; no leg drive; lower load ceiling
no leg drive; less systemic demand

contraindications: knee injury aggravated by the dip phase
shoulder impingement under loaded overhead position
resistance_profile: leg drive initiates the press; resistance hardest through the mid-range once leg momentum transfers

provenance.notes: Whole-body explosive press. Allows heavier loads overhead than strict press. Higher systemic fatigue than strict due to full-body involvement. SFR heuristic.
